description: Round-2 neutron-gap probe per prop:full-pole-structure-mass-trace. Evaluates the FULL symbolic Markov trace tr_M(T_w, q_0) directly from the Habiro-coefficients witness — no Wedderburn-channel truncation, no V_3term approximation. Tests whether the −56% neutron residual from round-1 (PR #452) was the cyclotomic-residue truncation phenomenon. Read-only investigation.

data.verdict: h4_full_tr_M does NOT close the gap
data.recommendation: H4 (full tr_M) gives neutron err = -2.52e+08 ppb, still above 1e+07. The full pole structure alone does not account for the gap; the residual must live elsewhere — most likely in the assembly between tr_M and the brane-tower (T1 vs T1+T2+T3 mismatch), in Term 4/5/6 contributions not yet added, or in a normalisation/sign convention discrepancy. Next probe: compute T1+T4 (Frobenius co-Casimir) only (no brane tower) and see if that lands closer to CODATA, isolating the brane-tower contribution.
